text: ポケモンを　つかまえて　しらべれば　じどうてきに　ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえて　しらべれば
structure.en: if you catch Pokémon and examine them

structure.jp: じどうてきに　ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. しらべれば = 'if you examine them'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく says a change keeps going on from now. ふえて　いく = 'keep increasing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ adds a feeling of explaining how things are. んじゃ is the short old-man form. いくんじゃ = 'they go on, you see'.
